author: /root/swahili_translation
Urdu_target: کھیل میں متن درج کرنے کا خانہ
linguistic_reason: کھیل میں locates the control in the game. متن درج کرنے کا خانہ is a clear, grammatical Urdu noun phrase identifying the text-entry box, not terrain, a document file or a whole message. It preserves the generic accessible control name and contains no unapproved English fallback, placeholders or technical syntax. Read-only copy use is still a text box; the label does not assert that every instance is editable.

actual_source_context.mechanism: Module.textBridge.field creates real DOM input. Type is password or text. Password branch uses Password; non-password branch sets data-i18n-aria and aria-label from browserText(Game text field). refreshBrowserLanguage updates data-i18n-aria labels when locale changes. The control bridges native game text controls and can select a read-only value for copying.
actual_source_context.proof_limit: Production source inspected; no browser, screen-reader or assistive-technology execution claimed.

acceptance: Accept carrying all prior independently reviewed Urdu online keys, branches and English-retention dispositions forward because every old source and target value is identical; this one new label is separately reviewed here.
limits: This record updates source/catalog lineage only; actual app desktop/phone visual and screen-reader behavior remain separate validation gates.
